classification.difficultyReason: Infer a missing sector angle and convert a sector's fraction of a full turn into a percentage.

content.prompt: A charity uses its funds to provide food, shelter and employment training to homeless people. A pie chart is drawn to represent the different kinds of expenditure. The angles of the sectors for food and shelter are $109^\circ$ and $125^\circ$, respectively.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Which category receives the smallest part of the funds?

answer.worked: The employment-training sector has angle $360^\circ-109^\circ-125^\circ=126^\circ$. Food has the smallest sector angle, $109^\circ$, so it receives the smallest part of the funds.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What is the angle of the sector used to represent employment training?

answer.worked:
The sector angles add to $360^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Employment-training angle}&=360^\circ-109^\circ-125^\circ\\\text{Employment-training angle}&=126^\circ\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the percentage of the charity’s funds that is allocated to shelter. Give your answer to the nearest per cent.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage allocated to shelter}&=\frac{125}{360}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage allocated to shelter}&=\frac{625}{18}\%\\\text{Percentage allocated to shelter}&\approx35\%\end{align*}$$

So $35\%$ of the funds is allocated to shelter, to the nearest per cent.
